# IngredientArchive

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Formats` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public static class IngredientArchive
```

Reads and writes `.igt` archives — a manifest plus one PNG per variant, plus an optional depth map per variant. The `ZipArchive` overloads exist so a Recipe can nest one without going through a file.

## Methods

### Read(ZipArchive, Parallelism?) { #m-read-system-io-compression-ziparchive-nfty-core-parallelism }

```csharp
public static LoadedIngredient Read(ZipArchive zip, Parallelism? parallelism = null);
```

Reads an Ingredient from an already-open archive, decoding every variant PNG.

**Parameters**

- `zip` (`ZipArchive`) - The open archive.
- `parallelism` (`Parallelism?`) - How wide PNG encoding (or decoding) may run; null means [`Parallelism.Default`](Nfty.Core.Parallelism.md#p-default). Never changes the bytes.

**Returns.** The loaded ingredient; the caller owns it. Its manifest's `PartialAlpha` is recomputed from the decoded images rather than trusting the stored value.

**Exceptions**

- `InvalidDataException` - A stored depth entry's length disagrees with its variant image's dimensions.

### Write(ZipArchive, IngredientManifest, IReadOnlyDictionary&lt;string, Image&lt;Rgba32&gt;&gt;, IReadOnlyDictionary&lt;string, DepthMap&gt;, Parallelism?) { #m-write-system-io-compression-ziparchive-nfty-core-model-fd2a11 }

```csharp
public static void Write(ZipArchive zip, IngredientManifest manifest, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, Image<Rgba32>> variantImages, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, DepthMap> depths, Parallelism? parallelism = null);
```

Writes an Ingredient into an already-open archive.

**Parameters**

- `zip` (`ZipArchive`) - The open archive.
- `manifest` (`IngredientManifest`) - The ingredient's manifest. Its `PartialAlpha` is ignored — the written value is recomputed from `variantImages`.
- `variantImages` (`IReadOnlyDictionary<string, Image<Rgba32>>`) - One image per variant id.
- `depths` (`IReadOnlyDictionary<string, DepthMap>`) - Depth maps by variant id. A variant with no entry, or whose entry is flat once zeroed over transparency, gets no `depth/` entry at all. An entry whose key is not one of this manifest's variants is ignored.
- `parallelism` (`Parallelism?`) - How wide PNG encoding (or decoding) may run; null means [`Parallelism.Default`](Nfty.Core.Parallelism.md#p-default). Never changes the bytes.
